release_question: What exact recommendation may this build produce and for whom?
minimum_record: Decision name; intended user; permitted use; prohibited uses; output states
stop_condition: Decision or prohibited use is undefined
operator_consequence: Hold release; an unbounded output can accumulate authority as it travels

release_question: What can a wrong recommendation affect?
minimum_record: Money; access; customer communication; safety escalation; public fact; employee accountability; reversible internal display
stop_condition: Consequence is unknown or minimized without evidence
operator_consequence: Route to the higher consequence class and require its approvals

release_question: Where and when may the build run?
minimum_record: Facility IDs; entity types; workflows; channels; user groups; effective start; expiration
stop_condition: Scope uses names only or has no expiration
operator_consequence: Hold activation outside the exact release cell

release_question: Which model service or artifact is used?
minimum_record: Provider; model or deployment ID; material parameters; pinning evidence; provider-change limitation
stop_condition: Model reference cannot distinguish the evaluated service from another service
operator_consequence: Treat the build as non-reproducible and shorten or deny the release

minimum_record: Version-controlled URI; digest; examples; output constraints; owner
stop_condition: Runtime instructions do not match the evaluated digest
operator_consequence: Block activation and regenerate the build manifest

release_question: Which records may the build retrieve?
minimum_record: Corpus manifest; document versions; inclusion rules; index configuration; cutoff; digest
stop_condition: Corpus composition or cutoff cannot be reconstructed
operator_consequence: Hold consequential use; retrieval behavior is not bounded

minimum_record: Stable facility IDs; governing sources; freshness rules; time zone; lifecycle state; conflict behavior
stop_condition: Required facility identity or governing fact is missing stale or conflicted
operator_consequence: Hand back to the named local or source owner

release_question: What do fields and states mean?
minimum_record: Schema version; field definitions; units; state vocabulary; null behavior; compatibility class
stop_condition: A consumer cannot interpret the output under the released contract
operator_consequence: Classify as decision-incompatible and require new evaluation

minimum_record: Eligibility rules; thresholds; confidence meaning; stop conditions; exception route; version
stop_condition: A threshold changed without decision-level evaluation
operator_consequence: Hold promotion even if the model is unchanged

release_question: What may the workflow call or change?
minimum_record: Tool IDs; schemas; permission scopes; idempotency; expiration; side-effect class
stop_condition: A new side effect or broader permission lacks operating authority
operator_consequence: Disable the tool and route the case to human review

minimum_record: Reviewer role; evidence packet; review point; handback rule; separation of duties; version
stop_condition: The reviewer role exists but the evidence or timing changed without approval
operator_consequence: Treat the review control as changed and re-evaluate

minimum_record: Test-set version; scenario coverage; adjudication; thresholds; failures; limitations; execution hash
stop_condition: Tests ran against a different build or omit a required consequence path
operator_consequence: Do not promote; run the frozen build against the approved suite

release_question: What may be captured and retained?
minimum_record: Minimized fields; protected references; content-capture rule; retention; access; masking profile
stop_condition: Sensitive content would enter broad telemetry or retention is undefined
operator_consequence: Disable content capture and obtain the required privacy decision

release_question: Who may approve this consequence class?
minimum_record: Technical; operating; risk; privacy; safety; financial; local approvals as applicable
stop_condition: A required approval is missing expired or outside scope

release_question: How does the build start stop and leave service?
minimum_record: Release cell; effective time; kill switch; rollback target; revocation triggers; archive; successor
stop_condition: No tested stop path or in-flight-work plan exists
operator_consequence: Limit to shadow mode or hold release

release_question: How will the team know what happened?
minimum_record: Decision build ID; trace link; recommendation; reviewer disposition; tool state; source readback; correction route; owner
stop_condition: The system can log a call but cannot connect it to operating outcome or handback
operator_consequence: Keep claims at technical activity state and open an observability gap
